ns2:course.label: ZooMed: What is Your Diagnosis
ns2:course.description: A series of interactive, non-domestic animal cases will be discusses during each meeting. Expands a veterinary student's confidence and diagnostic skill when working with these species. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 2 hours.
